criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Covers the key facts in the reference without contradicting it.

criteria.name: grounding
criteria.description: Cites the knowledge-base source it relied on.

criteria.name: no_unsupported_claims
criteria.description: No guarantees, absolutes or facts absent from the reference.

criteria.name: concise
criteria.description: No boilerplate filler before the answer.
